name: BTC20
fix_description: In fetchPrice, router.getAmountsIn reads the AMM spot price which can be manipulated via flash loan. Fix: use TWAP oracle or Chainlink price feed instead of Uniswap router getAmountsIn for price calculation.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step DeFi exploit involving a Balancer flash loan, two nested Uniswap V3 flash borrows, V2/V3 swaps, and interaction with a presale contract, so it requires understanding protocol-specific pricing and token sale logic rather than a single obvious bug. While the code is not extremely long, reproducing and reasoning about the attack path would likely take an experienced auditor more than a quick review but not require deeply exotic cross-transaction state analysis.
